VERSION 3.28.0.172
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Timer {
                interval: 4000
                running: true
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("external::ankimarkable-pure", [], {}, false)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
